confirmMeaning.allocate: Reserve the full requested quantities in the source bin. The warehouse selects eligible lots; physical stock stays unchanged.
confirmMeaning.pick: Confirm that every allocated lot has been picked in full. This deducts physical stock and consumes the reservations. Partial picks and reversal are unavailable.
confirmMeaning.pack: Confirm that the whole order is packed. This records packing completion without carton or weight checks.
confirmMeaning.ship: Confirm dispatch of the packed order. This completes the order without another physical stock deduction.
confirmMeaning.cancel: Cancel this order permanently. Any allocated reservation is released; physical stock is unchanged. The order will disappear from the register.
